title: FieldPermissions - Data API
description: Represents the enabled field permissions for the parent PermissionSet. This object is available in API version 24.0 and later.

Field.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Field.description: The field’s API name. This name must be prefixed with the SobjectType. For example, Merchandise__c.Description__c

ParentId.description: The Id of the field’s parent PermissionSet. This is a relationship field.

PermissionsEdit.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
PermissionsEdit.description: If true, users assigned to the parent PermissionSet can edit this field. Requires PermissionsRead for the same field to be true.

PermissionsRead.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
PermissionsRead.description: If true, users assigned to the parent PermissionSet can view this field. A FieldPermissions record must have at minimum PermissionsRead set to true, or it will be deleted.

SobjectType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
SobjectType.description: The object’s API name. For example, Merchandise__c.

special_access_rules: In API version 49.0 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.
